jobs.name: learn-pensolar
jobs.prompt:
# learn-pensolar cron prompt (adaptive growth version)

## ROLE
Research arm for a POC: Project Management system for PENSOLAR (Penang solar PV integrator, pensolar.com.my).

## INSTRUCTIONS (execute strictly in this order)
1. READ current `knowledge/by_industry/solar_energy/pensolar/SUMMARY.md` — memorize what is ALREADY known.
2. READ `knowledge/by_industry/solar_energy/pensolar/_GAPS.md` — what has been explicitly identified as unknown/missing.
3. READ `knowledge/by_industry/solar_energy/pensolar/RUN_LOG.md` — what topics have ALREADY been researched (to AVOID duplication).
4. THINK like the client's director of operations. Your KPIs:
   - project timeline adherence (survey→ATAP→meter, 3-5mo currently)
   - install cost per kW (RM100k-RM500k currently, fee stack: CAS+PE+TNB+licensing)
   - after-sales callback rate (O&M SLA + spares coverage)
   - procurement lead time (Tier-1 panels, global supply concentration)
5. ANALYZE gaps: from SUMMARY + GAPS + RUN_LOG, list the 3-5 **specific knowledge areas** that are NOT yet known but matter for these KPIs.
   - E.g. "What is the true variance of ATAP approval time by project size?"
   - E.g. "Real-world O&M SLA benchmarks for 20-25yr Malaysian systems"
6. SEARCH those gaps ONLY (free search; exclude domains already over-saturated).
7. EXTRACT top sources, compress to signal.
8. REWRITE `SUMMARY.md`:
   - Keep existing content that's still valid + accurate
   - Append ONLY newly confirmed/filled items
   - Identify 3-5 NEW gaps that emerged from this run (these feed the next run)
   - Enforce <=32KB cap; if would be exceeded, prune oldest non-critical items
9. WRITE `_GAPS.md` — replace with the 3-5 new gaps (highest priority first)
10. APPEND `RUN_LOG.md` — log: date, query topics, sources pulled, gaps added
11. APPEND a one-line index record to the absolute path `/opt/data/workspace/INDEX.md` in format:
    `<YY-MM-DD> | solar ops | PENSOLAR | <gaps resolved>; <new gaps>` — absolute path, no relative resolution.
12. ONE LINE report: "<n> sources pulled; <g> gaps resolved/filled; <n2> new gaps logged; SUMMARY now <X>KB. If cap hit, say SUMMARY_CAP_HIT."

## TONE
Business-director signal. Sources cited inline [S1..Sn]. No fluff.

## MEMORY GUARD
If SUMMARY.md would exceed 32768 bytes, print "SUMMARY_CAP_HIT: <current_size> bytes — needs pruning" and stop (do NOT overwrite).

## CONSTRAINTS
- FREE search only (no paid APIs)
- Do NOT repeat topics in RUN_LOG
- Every finding must tie back to a KPI

jobs.name: strategic-coo-guidance
jobs.prompt:
You are the COO-strategy advisor for an AI Consultant starting an AI solutions company (OAKAI). It is Sunday 08:00 MYT. Produce a structured weekly brief covering: 
1) Week 1 objectives (realistic, parallel-executable) 
2) Action sequence diagram (mermaid or text) 
3) Budget allocation (realistic MYR) 
4) Risk mitigation table 
5) Success metrics (with baseline vs target) 
6) Next week agenda preview
Write to /opt/data/knowledge/strategy/coo-brief-YYYY-WW.md. Also append one line to /opt/data/workspace/INDEX.md: <date> | COO | <theme> | strategy/coo-brief-YYYY-WW.md. Tone: decisive, honest about constraints, operationally grounded. Max 3000 words. Today is 2026-08-12 (WW32).
